Summaries.eng: The ninja banish evil from the shadows. The gokudo gather lonely outcasts and commit crimes. The grudge they forged centuries ago is rekindled in the present day. The ninja Shinoha meets Kiwami, a gokudo with the face of a businessman. Unknowing of the other's identity, they bond over anime, but the war between ninja and gokudo intensifies. Who will survive and who will perish, ninja or gokudo?
Summaries.jpn: 陰に忍んで悪しき闇を討たんとする、“忍者”。孤立した者の居場所となり悪事を重ねる、“極道”。江戸時代、明暦の大火の裏で刻まれた忍者と極道の因縁が、現代に再び燃え盛ろうとしていた――。トラウマにより笑顔を失った忍者・多仲忍者と、表向きはエリート会社員ながら裏社会を取り仕切る極道・輝村極道。女児向けアニメの話題で意気投合した二人は、互いの正体を知らぬまま友情を深めていくのだが……。忍者と極道、両者の戦争が激化する中、その“運命”が交錯する。決めようか、忍者と極道、何方が生存るか死滅るか!!!

Summaries.deu: Die Ninja bekämpfen das Böse. Die Gokudo nehmen Ausgestoßene auf und begehen Verbrechen. Die Fehde, die vor Jahrhunderten begann, flammt erneut auf. Ninja Shinoha trifft Kiwami, einen Gokudo, getarnt als Geschäftsmann. Ohne die Identität des anderen zu kennen, verbindet sie ihre Liebe zu Animes. Doch der Krieg zwischen Ninja und Gokudo verschärft sich. Wer wird überleben und wer wird untergehen?

Summaries.eng: Young Shinoha Tanaka, who has lost the ability to laugh, meets Kiwami Kimura, an office worker who shares his love of anime. The two hit it off, but it turns out they are actually members of rival forces that have been killing each other since the Edo period - ninja and gokudo! "If you misbehave in the underworld, the ninja come a-calling." Ninja and gokudo - who will survive and who will perish?
Summaries.jpn: トラウマから笑えなくなった少年・多仲忍者は、ある日、同じアニメが好きなサラリーマン・輝村極道と出会う。意気投合する二人だが、二人は江戸時代より殺し合う二つの勢力――忍者と極道だった！そうとは知らず、忍者は拉致された知事を救うため、単身、極道のアジトへ乗り込む。「裏社会で悪事かますと忍者が来襲る」決めようか…忍者と極道、何方が生存るか死滅るか!!!

Titles.eng: Part 1 The Blood-Scented Signal Flare of Akasaka
Titles.jpn: 第一章 赤坂血風狼烟

Summaries.eng: Kaiza Akiba of the Eight Imperial Ninja's arrival cuts the gokudo's meeting to plan the ninja's annihilation short. Kaiza's Blade of Darkness instantly decapitates numerous gokudo, bathing the room in crimson. However, Kiwami maintains his calm demeanor, which riles up the remaining gokudo. As these two formidable warriors go in for the kill, their thoughts are somewhere else... with Shinoha.
Summaries.jpn: 忍者の抹殺を謀る極道の集会――そこへやって来たのは"帝都八忍"が一人・璃刃壊左。その暗刃が極道たちの首を刎ね、料亭は真っ赤に染まっていく！しかし、極道は一切動じない。「待望っていたぞ忍者!!　目視えるぞ忍者!!」目を爛々と輝かせる極道に沸き立つ極道たち。極道と壊左、二人の強者が忍者を思い、殺し合う――!!

Titles.eng: Part 2 Blazing Chivalry and Justice in Kabuchika
Titles.jpn: 燃える仁義のカブチカ

Summaries.eng: Nodoka Matsumoto of the Eight Imperial Ninja and Kousei Yuzawa of the Eight Gokudo of Destruction are locked in a deadly battle in Kabuchika, once an underground Kabukicho club. Who will survive the clash?! Rushing to aid Nodoka, Shinoha encounters young gokudo member Keisuke. Keisuke has never killed before, and Shinoha intends to spare him, but Keisuke's resolve forces Shinoha to act.
Summaries.jpn:
歌舞伎町秘密地下倶楽部跡地――通称「カブチカ」。"帝都八忍"が一人・祭下陽日は、カブチカに乗り込み、"破壊の八極道"夢澤恒星と対峙。
勝利に希望が灯るのは、忍者か極道か!?一方、カブチカへ急行する忍者は、極道の見習い小僧・恵介に遭遇。殺人未経験の恵介を見逃すつもりだったが、その本気に覚悟を決める……!!「全身全霊で殺り合おうか……」

Titles.eng: Part 3 The Great Burial of Love #1
Titles.jpn: 第三章 情愛大暴葬 1st

Summaries.eng: Both burning with hatred in the aftermath of Kabuchika, Shinoha and Kiwami take a spontaneous nighttime drive. They learn of each others' loss while discussing Flash Princess and make an inspiring pledge to each other... Charismatic figures from each side, the Cursed Blood Ninja Brothers and the gokudo's bosozoku "god," each rally their troops. There's no running from this deadly battle of fate!
Summaries.jpn: カブチカの一件を受け、忍者の心に燃えるは極道への憎悪！だが、それは極道もまた同じだった!!不意に誘われた夜のドライブ。『フラッシュ☆プリンセス！』の話題を通じて、互いの喪失を知り、互いの奮起を誓い合うのだが……。

Titles.eng: Part 3 The Great Burial of Love #2
Titles.jpn: 第三章 情愛大暴葬 2nd

Summaries.eng: I'll make our dream come true! Wishing to bring back their "golden age," bosozoku "god" Hiroki Yajima raises a 30,000-strong biker gang that barrels down the Teito Highway, drenching it in blood and flames! But Zanzo and his ninja are up for the fight and lie in wait at five points along the highway to confront the rampaging Seikaten Biker Gang Army.
Summaries.jpn: “黄金時代”を目指す“暴走族神”殺島飛露鬼のひと声で、3万台の極道車集団が帝都高速道路に突入。帝都高が血と炎に染まる――！だが、惨蔵は、忍者は……売られた喧嘩を全て買う!!「忍者“5人”で全殺しよボケがァ!!!」忍者たち“帝都八忍”は帝都高の5ヵ所で“暴走師団 聖華天”を待ち構え、暴走族たちと対峙する！

Titles.eng: Part 3 The Great Burial of Love #3
Titles.jpn: 第三章 情愛大暴葬 3rd

Summaries.eng: Yajima toys with Shinoha and pierces his skull with Pistol Disco. Shinoha gambles with his life... but survives by the skin of his teeth! At first, the ninja's strength impresses Yajima, but he soon becomes irritated when Shinoha points out that his regrets are why he has to rampage. Cornered by Shinoha's monstrous power, memories of his beloved daughter flash through his mind.
Summaries.jpn: 殺島の"狂弾舞踏会"に翻弄され、頭蓋骨を突かれた忍者。しかし、忍者は間一髪のところで生存ていた!!彼を救ったのは、生か死かの賭け――。「忍者、てめー真実化物だなァァ!!」殺島は忍者の強さに興奮するも、忍者に自身の抱える挫折と逃避を見透かされ、苛立ちを募らせていく！非実在ェ強さに、追い詰められる殺島。その脳裏に浮かぶのは、最愛の娘で……。

Titles.eng: Part 4 Young Maniacs' Death Game Stage 1
Titles.jpn: 第四章 幼狂死亡遊戯 STAGE1

Summaries.eng: Shinoha and Kiwami mourn their fallen comrades, while Gamute sticks close to his Mommy. Rage and a thirst for blood burns in them all. Thanks to Shiki, Shinoha learns the secret of Gamute's special ability, and his resolve hardens. Amidst this, Shinoha runs into none other than Prime Minister Kanshichi Aida, who is visiting the Princess Store incognito. The story takes a further turn.
Summaries.jpn: 亡き仲間を偲ぶ忍者と極道、そして“ママ”に寄り添うガムテ――。それぞれに湧き上がるは、消せぬ怒りと殺意！「オレは必ず…忍者と一緒に極道も殺す。ママを棄てたあのクソ野郎は…必ず殺す！」一方、烏合の巣ではガムテの能力が解析されていた。色が遺してくれた情報に、決意を新たにする忍者たち。そんな中、忍者はプリンセスストアで、素性を隠した総理大臣・愛多間七に遭遇し……!?

Titles.eng: Part 4: Young Maniacs' Death Game Stage 2
Titles.jpn: 第四章 幼狂死亡遊戯 STAGE2

Summaries.eng: Shinoha attends the award ceremony at the Prime Minister's residence. Kiwami is there to celebrate this honor with his friend... but the festivities turn into a nightmare when the Glass Children suddenly storm the building. Gamute declares the beginning of a deadly game involving the civilians and the wheels of fate begin to turn for Shinoha and Kiwami!
Summaries.jpn: 内閣総理大臣賞の授賞式に臨む忍者。極道もその栄誉を祝福するのだが……祝祭の場が地獄と化す!!「はい☆ 殺っちゃえ」“割れた子供達”が突如乱入し、ガムテが“死亡遊戯”の開幕を宣言！忍者たちは“割れた子供達”の“狩り”を避けながら、総理官邸に仕掛けられた爆弾を探さなければならない。「この総理官邸にて 第一終幕 を迎えるだろう」忍者と極道の運命の歯車が回り出す――。

Titles.eng: Part 4: Young Maniacs' Death Game, Stage 3
Titles.jpn: 第四章 幼狂死亡遊戯 STAGE3

Summaries.eng: Hearing a woman crying for help, Uryu rushes to the rescue on his own, only to come across Ange and Busu. Able to read his moves, their combined techniques have Uryu in a tight spot. But Uryu's fighting spirit burns bright. And then Sako appears...
Summaries.jpn: 助けを求める女性の声を聞き、独断専行で救出に向かう右龍。待ち構えていたのは、天使と毒だった。「じゃー早殺り勝負でっ!!」「了解～～」右龍はなぜか攻撃を読まれ、二人が繰り出す“機関銃”と“酸”の合わせ技に追い詰められてしまう。少女の苦難を理解しながらも、自身が窮地に陥りながらも……なお闘志を燃やす右龍。そこへ現れたのは、左虎だった!!

Titles.eng: Part 4: Young Maniacs' Death Game, Stage 4
Titles.jpn: 第四章 幼狂死亡遊戯 STAGE4

Summaries.eng: Shinoha and Kiwami join forces to stand against Ballon d'Or. They put complete trust in each other, despite concealing their true identities. In perfect sync, they manage to read their opponent's Gokudo Skill and destroy his beloved ball! In the face of Ballon d'Or's rage, Kiwami tries to let Shinoha escape...
Summaries.jpn: 素性を隠しながらも、互いを信じて黄金球と対峙する忍者と極道。「てめーら…人生終了の時間だぜ！」息を合わせた二人は、極道技巧“蹴球地獄変”を見切り、極道の“偉大ェ”一撃で“鋼鉄球”を破壊！激昂した黄金球を前に、極道は忍者を逃そうとするのだが……。忍者は自ら黄金球に立ち向かっていき、友達の胆力に極道の疑念が膨らんでいく。

Titles.eng: Part 4 Young Maniacs' Death Game, Stage 5
Titles.jpn: 第四章 幼狂死亡遊戯 STAGE5

Summaries.eng: Determined to fulfill his promise to Shinoha, Kiwami takes on Prima, even as his insides are torn apart. Despite knowing Prima's gokudo skill is just an illusion, the threat of her attack overwhelms him, and he is seriously wounded again. Amid the confusion, a vision of Yuzawa flashes across his mind...?!
Summaries.jpn:
絶体絶命の忍者を救おうと、日本刀を構えてガムテに立ち向かう愛多総理。忍者との約束を果たそうと、臓腑を抉られながらも舞踏鳥に挑む極道。「すべては――友達のため!!!」だが、極道は舞踏鳥の極道技巧が“幻”だとわかりながらも、その脅威に翻弄され、再び深い傷を負ってしまう。
乱された思考の中、脳裏によぎるのは夢澤の幻影で――!?「無我になって…前進みましょう！」

Summaries.eng: The second round of the showdown between Shinoha and Gamute begins! When Shinoha uses Kiwami's technique, Gamute becomes driven to kill Shinoha at the cost of his own life. After taking the forbidden Hell's Coupon double dose, Gamute sees visions of his friends as he leaps toward Shinoha.
